title: Manager: loose ends left by task 057 (for_retry on step-3 parks and merges, protected check against the fork point)
item: Fix the minor points the task 057 review and builder found: a step-3 park erases an earlier for_retry, a merge leaves for_retry on a Done task, step 8 says 'the branch stays' when a step-3 park has no branch, SKILL.md rule 2 does not mention the for_retry exception, and checks.py protected compares a task branch's task file with the working branch's current copy instead of the copy at the fork point
motivation: Task 057 review 057-1 (minor 2, 3, 4, 6) and the builder's notes. Today no task has for_retry or outside_needs, so none of these has bitten yet; the fork-point one will bite the first time the owner sets owner_verified on the working branch while that task's branch is open.
notes: Not included, left for the owner: the review's minor 1 (confirm claude-haiku-5-5 and the ant argument form; the builder reports three real calls that passed on 2026-11-17), minor 5 (re-run needs before the retry builder), minor 7 (credential mask shape), and the builder's points that nothing stops the manager setting owner_verified on the working branch, and that step 4 has no 'merge the earlier branch as it stands' path for a task like 049.
draft_note: Drafted by the manager on 2026-11-17 from the task 057 review. Priority, done_means and may_edit left for the owner; every change is under .claude/skills/manage/, which is protected, so may_edit needs it.
